Lena (support): FYI urgent customer escalation from AcmeCorp — p95/p99 token latency spikes after yesterday's function-calling + structured-output validation rollout. UI timeouts in their app. @Samir @Jess can you triage?

Lena (support): Repro steps provided by customer:
1) curl against our /v1/chat/completions with tool calls enabled
2) include validate_output: true and a nested tool args payload
Example request:
```json
{ \"model\": \"redwood-tool-alpha\", \"messages\": [{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Find coords for 1600 Amphitheatre\"}], \"tool_calls\": [{\"name\": \"geocode\", \"args\": {\"q\": \"1600 amphitheatre\"}}], \"validate_output\": true }
```
Request IDs: r=abc123, r=abc124 (from customer logs)
Observed before rollout: p95 ~120ms, p99 ~320ms
Observed now: p95 ~680ms, p99 ~2200ms

Samir (eng-runtime): I'm pulling traces for those request ids. Early signal: tool-router spans show heavy time in a span labeled "schema-validator" which is a call out to our validation service. It looks like we are doing a synchronous RPC per tool-call that serializes the payload, sends it, waits, then resumes. Span ids: span-7f3a, span-7f3b.

Samir (eng-runtime): Quick note: validator svc was rolled with a stricter schema yesterday (PR 4217). That increases complexity — some objects now trigger deep canonicalization which is O(n) on nested keys.

Jess (eng-ml): Confirming from model telemetry: we also see token insertion for structured-output templates which increases model compute and KV cache pressure. The orchestration path adds ~80-120ms per tool call before token generation; the external schema validator adds ~150-400ms depending on payload size. Combined can push p99 into seconds for multi-tool flows.

Lena (support): Customer says top-level stack: frontend -> Redwood hosted API -> tool-router -> validator -> model. They see frontend timeouts after >1.5s.

Mike (oncall): Immediate mitigation options (fast):
- toggle off strict schema validation for affected customer via feature-flag (hosted)
- route that customer's traffic to a fallback path that bypasses tool-router (model-only generation)
- enable a short-circuit where requests with \"validated\":true skip external validation
We can do the first two in <30m. @Samir can you run the flag? :thumbsup:

Samir (eng-runtime): I'm applying a flag to disable strict-validator for the Acme account and adding a temporary bypass for known-safe tool signatures. Pushing patch to canary now. Commands I ran:
```bash
# toggle flag
redwoodctl flags set acme.strict_validator false --env canary
# quick bypass rule
redwoodctl rules add --owner acme --match \"tool.name:geocode\" --action bypass_validator
```
Patch PR: https://git.internal/r/patch/4289

deploy-bot: deploy started for feature/disable-strict-validator -> canary -> prod (initiated by Samir)

Lena (support): Notifying customer about a short maintenance window while we test.

Jess (eng-ml): Long-term mitigations we should consider:
- move validation in-proc (C++ module) to avoid RPC overhead
- async validation with optimistic path: let request proceed and post-validate, emit correction events if needed
- batch/aggregate validations for multiple tool calls in a single RPC
- schema caching and canonicalization memoization for repeated payload shapes
- reduce token inflation: compact structured-output serialization, minimize templates
I can draft an evaluation doc for perf tradeoffs.

Mike (oncall): I've created incident INC-2026-451, assigned eng-runtime + eng-ml. Monitor dashboards: p95/p99 per-customer, tool-router latency, validator success latencies.

Lena (support): Customer reported partial improvement after the flag. New numbers: p95 ~210ms, p99 ~640ms. Still above baseline but much better. They can hold for a fuller fix.

Samir (eng-runtime): Rolling the flag to prod now. Will follow up with a short postmortem and a mitigation plan.

Lena (support): Thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated with the customer's feedback.

Mike (oncall): Follow-ups: Samir to propose quick in-proc validator PoC, Jess to quantify token inflation per schema (delta tokens and cost), Lena to gather a small set of failing payloads for unit tests.

Lena (support): Adding payload samples to the ticket. Closing loop with customer. :white_check_mark:
